answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the nebula graph. Re-attestations are stored in cedar and pulse lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 423 impostors cost 638 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
